description: Bounded implementation queue for the civilization simulation. Tasks must be implemented and verified against the product contract.

tasks.title: Complete first interactive civilization vertical slice
tasks.objective: Create a deterministic starter world with two settlements, run population/food/timber/treasury transitions, expose create/inspect/step API commands, and connect them to a real Leptos browser interface.
acceptance: A seed creates the same initial world and deterministic future state
Two settlements expose population, food, timber and treasury
A tick changes domain state and emits causal versioned events
HTTP tests cover create, inspect, step, missing world and overflow rollback
Browser controls call the real API and render returned state
All release-readiness CI gates pass on the exact PR head

tasks.title: Independent readiness review on every implementation PR
tasks.objective: Have the simulation QA and release-readiness agent profiles inspect exact PR head commits, invariants, browser integration and GitHub Actions evidence before merge.
acceptance: Exact commit SHA recorded
Formatting, Clippy, workspace tests, WASM check and release build are green
No unresolved high-severity review findings
Readiness report links to CI run and commit

tasks.title: Define geography and spatial primitives
tasks.objective: Add typed coordinates, regions, terrain, water bodies, climate bands and map adjacency to game-core without embedding presentation or persistence concerns.
acceptance: Units and coordinate conventions are explicit
Adjacency and region invariants have tests
Serialization round-trips preserve domain state

tasks.title: Model ecology and renewable resource flows
tasks.objective: Implement climate, soil, water, biomass and renewable/non-renewable resource stocks as connected state transitions with explicit units and conservation constraints.
acceptance: Every quantity has an explicit unit
Stock/flow conservation invariants are tested
Unknown inputs are not silently replaced with zero

tasks.title: Add population cohorts and households
tasks.objective: Model births, deaths, age cohorts, household membership, skills, health and migration as domain entities with explicit time semantics.
acceptance: Population transitions are deterministic for a fixed seed and ruleset
Household membership invariants are tested
Birth/death/migration events retain causal metadata

tasks.title: Add labor, production and inventories
tasks.objective: Implement production functions, labor allocation, inventories and goods with explicit quantities and units. Do not mix prices or financial balances into physical stock quantities.
acceptance: Production consumes declared inputs and produces declared outputs
Inventory cannot become negative
Tests cover input constraints and output conservation

tasks.title: Add exchange, logistics and trade
tasks.objective: Model transport capacity, routes, transaction settlement, supply and demand across settlements with explicit ownership and provenance.
acceptance: Trade cannot create goods or money
Ownership changes are recorded as events
Route capacity and failed settlement are tested

tasks.title: Introduce double-entry accounting
tasks.objective: Implement currencies, accounts, balanced journal entries, credit, debt, interest and default as a financial subsystem separate from physical resource inventories.
acceptance: Every posted journal entry balances
Currency and minor-unit precision are explicit
Credit/default transitions are auditable and tested

tasks.title: Connect inheritance to ownership and institutions
tasks.objective: Integrate dynasty-core succession and inheritance with ownership records in game-core while preserving legal rules and historical context as scenario data.
acceptance: Inheritance transfers ownership without creating assets
Competing claims can be represented
Succession is deterministic and auditable

tasks.title: Add versioned world command and query endpoints
tasks.objective: Expose world creation, inspect, pause, step and fast-forward through typed /api/v1 endpoints with validation and stable error codes.
acceptance: HTTP contract tests cover success and validation failures
Commands are idempotent where required
No internal error details or secrets leak in responses

tasks.title: Build world creation and observation flows
tasks.objective: Implement a responsive Leptos interface for scenario creation, world inspection, event history and pause/step/fast-forward controls using the typed API.
acceptance: All controls call real API behavior
Loading, empty, unavailable and error states are distinct
Keyboard and narrow-screen use are verified

agent_roles.responsibility: Adversarial invariant, replay and regression testing
